summary: Every acceptance criterion has implementing work on the swept commits: V01-V04 and V15 (P1's tests/pom.xml pin and trusted-shell harness, with both reds and the vars/ probe witnessed), V08 and V14 (P2's iac_toolchain template, with modern_app_dev left in place), V05 and V06 (P3's Test stage before both kaniko stages), V09-V12 (P4's alert-rules.sh, 5 files and 8 alerts with firing and quiet cases, and all six slice-018 scenarios in node-memory-pressure.yml), and V13 (P5's D61). V07 is the live witness after the push, which belongs to the test phase, and the README and values.yaml comment leftovers are addressed to the doc phase. No ruling goes undelivered, and no phase depends on something nothing produced. The remaining leftovers are advisory (S2, S4) or operator questions (Q1) and stay in the close-out. S3 and S5 were comment-only residue in files the slice touched: they are fixed in ArgoCDTools c32a27c and AnsibleSpecs 7844b5c and struck, and A1 is struck as done.
